_comment: 8 Ukrainian letters are missing from the 3DS system font (verified: assets/font_charset.txt, 7501 code points, Cyrillic is the 66-glyph JIS set). Substitution happens in build.py before the MSBT is assembled. The active variant is chosen by the 'default' key.

greek._comment: є/Є -> Greek epsilon: keeps them distinct from 'е', looks foreign but reads unambiguously

cyrillic._comment: є/Є -> 'е/Е': looks natural but loses Ukrainian orthography (мае, единий)

real._comment: the real letters, unchanged. Opt-in: only for a console whose shared system font has been given them (tools/sysfont_glyphs.py, docs/internals.en.md). Picked with GLYPHS=real (env UA_GLYPHS), never as the default

also_missing._comment: the modifier apostrophe U+02BC is absent, so ASCII U+0027 is used
